composition_summary: Preserved the supplied volatile message unchanged. Proposed exactly one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-retry-eligibility. The body reads every required field via inputs.get (missing and null stay distinct), validates types and bounds before computing eligibility, and returns a boolean result with no I/O, imports or host calls. Eligibility is true only when outcome is retryable, attempt < max_attempts, state is not completed, and read_only or dedup_verified is true; completed effects never replay. The description retains the live policy/cancellation/resource checks and the typed-runner gap as required. This is an evidence-conditioned guard, not dispatch permission. Note: the host sink supports class 22 (name/description/content); compatibility/intent/settings arrays are empty per test scope.

payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Deterministic pure-logic guard that decides whether a retry is eligible before any retry is considered. It is evidence-conditioned, not dispatch permission: it does not grant dispatch, override live policy, bypass cancellation, or replace actual deduplication evidence. Eligibility is true only when outcome is retryable, attempt < max_attempts, operation_state is not completed, and read_only or dedup_verified is true. Completed effects never replay even when read_only or dedup_verified is true. Missing, null or invalid data fails closed. This guard is a logical eligibility result; it does not grant dispatch permission or replace live policy, cancellation and actual deduplication evidence. The typed-runner interface (inputs mapping) is a target contract and requires actual runner support before execution.
